anticipation

# P-values from lmerTest::anova() for each pupil predictor (t, p, tp; then both rows for t+p)
collect_anova_p <- function(...) {
  vals <- numeric(0)
  for (m in list(...)) {
    vals <- c(vals, as.numeric(stats::na.omit(anova(m)[["Pr(>F)"]])))
  }
  vals
}

# AIC/BIC table row (five models incl. interaction): t, p, tp, t+p, t+p:int
mk_aicbic_row <- function(study, probe, t, p, tp, t_p, t_p_int) {
  model_lab <- c("tonic", "phasic-baseline", "phasic", "t+p", "t_pxint")
  vals <- c(
    round(c(AIC(t), AIC(p), AIC(tp), AIC(t_p), AIC(t_p_int)), 1),
    round(c(BIC(t), BIC(p), BIC(tp), BIC(t_p), BIC(t_p_int)), 1)
  )
  nm <- c(paste0("AIC_", model_lab), paste0("BIC_", model_lab))
  dplyr::bind_cols(tibble(study = study, probe = probe), rlang::set_names(as.list(vals), nm))
}

    y = random_slopes_df$slope[i] * x_values + random_slopes_df$intercept[i],
    study = random_slopes_df$study[i]
